sourceState: Base commit plus the narrow working-tree cleanup correction; hashes below identify the exact tested source.

rootCause.summary: After TERM and reaping the timed leader, Darwin can return EPERM for the remaining zombie-only process group. The group may disappear before a process-table snapshot.

fix: Only an exited leader plus a bounded (0.5 second) signal-zero probe reaching ESRCH can turn EPERM into confirmed group absence. Persistent/live/unobservable groups still raise. No second signal is sent after a group is confirmed absent.

coverage: Real TERM-resistant parent and descendant killed after timed leader exit
Output cap/deadline and real RSS checks

performanceAttribution.note: Earlier performance values remain those recorded with the pre-correction benchmark source; this note tests cleanup semantics only.

limitations: Process groups contain cooperating/trusted subprocesses; detached processes are outside this lifecycle guarantee.
Only task-created sleeping/TERM-resistant fixtures were launched; no project code, scanner, build or installer ran for this cleanup acceptance.
